articles.title: Iran brands Argentina’s navy and air force terrorists in payback move
articles.description: Argentina blacklisted Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps in March following U.S. pressure on allies. Iran retaliated by designating Argentina’s navy and air force as terrorist groups. Buenos Aires cited the Guard’s backing of Hezbollah, which it blames for two deadly 1990s bombings.
